description: This file defines the RecipeRepository interface, which provides methods for accessing and manipulating recipe data, including fetching, searching, filtering, and managing favorites. It serves as an abstraction layer for data operations related to recipes in the app.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: An interface abstraction for recipe data access, supporting various data sources such as remote REST APIs or local databases.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of all recipes available.

methods.name: searchRecipes
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of recipes matching the provided search query.

methods.name: getRecipesByCategory
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting recipes that belong to a specific category.

methods.name: getRecipeById
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the recipe with the specified ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getFavorites
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the list of favorite recipes.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a boolean indicating whether the specified recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: A suspend function to toggle the favorite status of a given recipe.
